title: JAY’ED - Time after Time / CYNDI LAUPER [WA]

lines.l: I fall behind, suitcase of memories, time after, sometimes you picture me, I'm walking too far ahead, you're calling to me, I can't hear what you've said, then you say, go slow, I fall behind.
If you're lost, you can look and you will find me
If you fall, I will catch you, I'll be waiting
If you're lost, you can look and you will find me
If you fall, I will catch you, I'll be waiting
And darkness has turned to cry
If you're lost you can look and you will find me
If you fall I will catch you I'll be waiting
If you're lost you can look
If you fall, I will catch you, I'll be waiting
